title: Army-CJNG Clash in Jilotlán de los Dolores, Jalisco Leaves 4 Suspected Gunmen and a Soldier Dead
detail: On September 11, 2026 (Friday), Mexican Army Special Forces, National Guard, the FGR, and three Mexican Air Force helicopters raided two suspected CJNG narco-camps in the municipality of Jilotlán de los Dolores, southern Jalisco, following military intelligence work to locate the camps. Personnel came under gunfire while clearing the camps; in the exchange, four suspected gunmen were killed. Two soldiers were wounded and evacuated by helicopter to the Military Hospital in Apatzingán, Michoacán, where one later died, bringing the operation's total death toll to five. Seized items included a .50-caliber Barrett rifle, four additional long guns, roughly 138 improvised explosive devices, ammunition, and tactical clothing, plus six vehicles (one factory-armored). A related operation the same day in Santa María del Oro separately dismantled a clandestine methamphetamine lab, seizing industrial reactors and condensers, over 1,600 liters of precursor chemicals, 1,140 kg of ammonia powder, and 150 kg of calcium chloride.

confidenceReason: MVS Noticias explicitly dates the clash to September 11, 2026, and Vanguardia's Sep 12 report ('operativo realizado este viernes') independently confirms the same Friday date; the clash, casualties, and seized items are further corroborated by La Crónica de Hoy. Corrects a prior run's misdating of this event to Sep 13 (the date La Crónica de Hoy published, not the date of the clash). The suspects' formal CJNG affiliation is the outlets' attribution pending judicial confirmation.
